brief_extract:
APRIL, 1945

The Gotaplatsen Square with Art Museum in the centre ; new Municipal Theatre to the left ; and Concert Hall to the right. VISIT TO SWEDEN AND FINLAND
By Caroline Haslett

THE four main subjects of my lecture-tour for the British Council were "The Mobilisation of British Women at War"; "British Women and Post-War Planning"; "Britain's Post-War Housing Policy"; "Post-War Domestic Electrification," of great interest to electrical engineers cut off from the main trend of development in Britain and America. All these themes had variants in the first ten days in Stockholm, in visits to factories and electrical undertakings north of Stockholm, in the University City of Uppsala, in Lund and Malmo in South Sweden, and in Gothenburg on the west coast.
